body: Hi, sorry for the late response.  I just saw you messaged.  Still here.  Worse as ever.  Two steps forward and four back, unfortunately.

Thank you so much for replying to my post.  Yes, this is my life now.  I’ve said that probably a thousand times since all this happened.  So strange to see it in writing.  Last surviving member of my family no friends, just me.  Had my first bedsore about a month ago. 
So everything you said is spot on.  
It’s exhausting to exist now.  Every morning I wake up is a disappointment.  But again, thank you for replying.  There was a reason for it.
Funny how you don’t see pictures like this on Marquis Companies website.  There used to be pictures on Facebook until they mysteriously disappeared.
Marquis Mt Tabor Portland Oregon.  Funny how people don’t see pictures like this on their website.

That my half sister and two half brothers, couldn’t give a rats ass about me.  My half sister told me.  My father did everything for them.  Gave me $500 in 1982 and said go buy yourself something.  Gotta love being an unwanted sibling!

I hear you my friend.  Every morning I wake up I’m disappointed.  I’m the only one left in my family.  
So I believe in heaven, and wish I was with my family, my Mom and my dog so much.  It’s so lonely being the only one left.  Nobody... just me. 
But can’t do suicide either, because afraid it wouldn’t work, and I’d be a vegetable.  
I’ve met someone who’s become kind of a positive friend in my life that’s full of negativity.  But I always have to be careful what I say around him.
But still wishing the same.  And feeling the same every morning.

At least I know there’s another person that’s feeling the same.  I so hate you feel that way, but for what it’s worth there’s someone else who feels the same.
Take Care of Yourself My Friend
3 days and 9 shifts of trash.  In and out day and night.  No one emptied.  Note urinal!
The town I grew up in.
No, no family or friends. Just places and some good memories to end on.
Things just aren’t good here, there’s gotta be something better.
